angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 673,438 km at 105.82 pc = 0.09 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.4499 +/- 0.0158 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 105.82 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.968 +/- 0.018 solar radii from Osborn et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 110113 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.502.4842O/abstract): 673,438 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.997 +/- 0.06 solar masses from Osborn et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 110113 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.502.4842O/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5732 +/- 50 K from Osborn et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 110113 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.502.4842O/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Osborn et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 110113 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.502.4842O/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-110113.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.465, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 110113 (pscomppars): spectral type G, from Osborn et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.502.4842O/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 110113: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 110113 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.14 dex, from Osborn et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.502.4842O/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 110113 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.03235, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 110113 (pscomppars): age 4 Gyr, from Osborn et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.502.4842O/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 110113 (pscomppars): rotation period 20.8 d, from Osborn et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.502.4842O/abstract)

rotationPeriodsCatalogued.source: VizieR J/A+A/661/A101/tableb4 (Magnetic moments of rocky planets), column Prot: 2.541 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 110113 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.74 km/s, from Osborn et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.502.4842O/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.968 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.739. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
